shots.action: He rises with his card in hand and smiles at the team; the grill smoke drifts upward.
He hands his card at the counter; the coworkers behind him bow slightly and smile.
He reads the phone and smiles softly, thumb scrolling once; the lamp light is warm.
The coworkers keep chatting and laughing; he glances at the bill folder and back up.
He finishes speaking; the coworkers freeze and exchange awkward glances.
The young coworker tilts his head with a pitying smile; the manager looks down.
He stares at the phone and slowly sets it down; the coworkers behind laugh together.
He walks slowly forward under the streetlight, head slightly lowered.
The two men lift their coffee cups and laugh naturally; steam rises from the cups.
